description: Mahonia's cited gear catalog. With query: a fuzzy search by brand, product or kind of gear ("duplex", "zpacks", "quilt"), best first, each result a catalog row with its id, the cited weight in grams and whether it is verified. With product_id (a row id from a search), or brand and name: every variant of that one product (sizes, lengths, temperature ratings) with the weight and source of each. A row on a list that names a catalog_id takes the catalog's brand, variant, gear type and weight.

brand.description: With name, instead of a query: the product's maker.

limit.description: Matches to return, up to 25. Default 12.

name.description: With brand, instead of a query: the product name without brand or variant.

product_id.description: Instead of a query: a catalog row id, for that product's variants.

query.description: What to search for: two characters or more, or a single Chinese character.

name: search_catalog

product.description: The product looked up, when one was.

name.description: The product name, without brand or variant.

query.description: The query as searched: trimmed, at most 100 characters. On a search.

results.description: A search's matches, best first; or a product's variants, in variant order.

category.description: The catalog's category: shelter, sleep, pack, and so on.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is: Tent, Quilt, Trail runners.

id.description: The catalog row id, the one create_list and edit_list take as catalog_id.

name.description: The product name, without brand or variant.

source_url.description: The page the weight was read from. On a product's variants.

variant.description: Size, length or rating; null on a product sold one way.

verified.description: Whether the cited weight has been verified.

weight_g.description: The cited weight in grams, to a tenth.

title: Search the gear catalog
